limits: Images are fixed prototype illustrations, not rigged models, full sprite sheets or original extracted assets.
NPC and vehicle/ship illustrations grant no character recruitment, statistics, pilotage, interiors or canonical ownership.
Mod graphics are original family concepts; they do not identify a named original module model.
Primary references corroborate only the limited visible details of Mako, Normandy SR-1 and Vindicator. The remaining character and enemy artwork is not primarily visually verified.
PNG alpha includes soft translucent edges and background remnants; no pixel-perfect cutout or artistic 1:1 claim.
